question: Does easier relation access improve fixed classifier reward transfer?
run_name: Can relation access transfer reward? | fixed critic DGPO | FiLM with V MSE 1
primary_endpoint: Difference in held-out ALL-sample mean fixed reward gain at1000 updates, enhanced-minus-raw. Same frozen critic and logit scale, same update/rollout budgets,4096 independent IID contexts with K8 averaged within context. Paired simultaneous intervals include each arm versus source. Fresh relative-feature width128 classifiers at0/25/100/300/1000 and order1/2/3 mode errors diagnose content, not mandatory closure.
decision_rule: Stage1 must have adequate fits and show material BCE plus mode-content benefit for the reviewer-selected representation. Require explicit CLI representation and review note. Reward-transfer support requires enhanced-minus-raw lower95 > +0.01. Report reference velocity distance, per-context gain, shape/mode decomposition, fresh fit adequacy and joint errors separately. An undertrained fresh audit is unresolved, never closure; it does not erase valid fixed-reward measurements. No requirement for monotonic AUC. Stop at1000 and summarize; do not auto-extend.
scope: Two new matched trajectories, not reuse of old FiLM trajectories. Both are frozen original-source generation plus a zero-at-start learned correction. Only the immutable source decodes scalar c; learned correction has zero legacy c input and reads visible features through three nonlinear scale+shift FiLM blocks. B or C changes only its condition basis. Backbone LR1e-4, AdamW WD.001, clipping1, K8, four times, DDIM50; half velocity-MSE coefficient1, original native detached gate/unscaled LOO, no EMA/refit/tempering. Optimizer/RNG/original reference persist across audits. This does not test ordinary diffusion pretraining, extreme ESS, exact endpoint KL, or real EveNet. No seed replication, remote job, upload or automatic next round.
